publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper a special electric transformer which allows achieving multiple polyphase systems (two-phase, five-phase and six-phase) from the three-phase power grid, using different connection schemes, is presented. The purpose of such an electric transformer is to offer the possibility of easily obtain different multiphase electric systems from the available three-phase power system, in electric machines laboratory for supplying polyphase motor drives, lately used on a large scale and variety. Connection schemes, phasor diagrams and turn ratios along with experimental data acquisitions are illustrated.

articleTitle: The study of the electric parameters of an autonomous supply system with photovoltaic panel
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents a battery charging system that uses a photovoltaic panel and determines the charging current at different levels of solar illumination. In the analysis of photovoltaic cells, one must bear in mind that the light reaches the cell in various amounts, the cell is exposed to significant temperature variations during its operation, the solar panels differ in size and, of course, various loads and power consumers are connected to the output of the solar panels. The impossibility of creating constant conditions in natural lighting and temperature leads to the necessity to design systems able to determine, at any given time, the point of maximum transfer from the solar cells. Generally speaking, in addition to the panels, we required a storage battery able to deliver energy in the absence of sunlight, a voltage regulator to prevent the battery overcharging, a disconnection device to be used when the battery is discharged below the limit, a measuring device to indicate the power flow direction and the amount of electric power produced / consumed.

articleTitle: The impact of the support scheme on the installed capacity in renewable energy sources in Romania
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: For encouraging and supporting the production of electrical energy from renewable energy sources, it was conceived a set of rules which is based on the existence of green certificates and a mandatory quota system. This paper presents an analysis of the impact of the support scheme on the investments in renewable energy sources in Romania. It also presents the evolution of the centralized green certificates market and the contribution of the renewable energy sources for the electricity production of Romania.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic pollution in urban areas
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The aim of this research is to perform a quick and mainly qualitative evaluation of the environmental radio frequency electromagnetic fields in some apartments and public places that are representative for most of the exposure situations that can occur in urban areas. This study can be a starting base for developing a risk of exposure evaluation questionnaire. Two types of exposure situations are considered in measurements: places situated in the vicinity (but in far field zone) of the main sources and places situated remotely from main sources. Also an exposure evaluation is performed for each case, taking into account the pollution from all sources together. There were found field levels of about tens to hundreds of mV/m and relative exposure of about 5×10-5 to 8×10-5 in the “source vicinity” cases and about few to tens of mV/m and relative exposure of about 3×10-6 to 1.4×10-5 in the “remotely by source” cases.

articleTitle: On the transient short circuit torque expression of induction machines
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper the transient electromagnetic torque expressions of an induction machine have been deduced and analyzed in the case of a three-phase short circuit of the supply network. Starting from the precise mathematical expressions for stator and rotor currents in the short circuit transient, the expressions of the electromagnetic torque have been established. Two damping components with the same low time constant have been highlighted: a sinusoidal one and a constant one. Due to the complicated form of the final expressions, simplified formulas for parameter expressions have been deduced in order to calculate the maximum torque value. Conclusions regarding the nature and the duration of the transient electromagnetic torque have been drawn.

articleTitle: Case studies on electromagnetic interference between HVPL and buried pipelines
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Electromagnetic interferences between an existing gas pipeline and a newly designed high voltage power line sharing the same right-of-way, are evaluated. Induced voltages are computed for different steady state power line operating conditions, using dedicated professional software. To increase results accuracy, soil resistivity measurements were made along distribution corridor length and the appropriate equivalent soil model is determined. Obtained induced AC voltages values are compared to international regulation for identification of potentially hazardous zones regarding pipeline corrosion. Different mitigation techniques are tested and proposed.

articleTitle: Planar impedancemetric NO sensor with thick film mixed dy-based oxides sensing electrodes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The pastes destined for sensing electrodes were prepared by mixing Dy-based oxides powders with organic vehicle. The sensing electrodes of interdigitated structure were screen printed onto yttria stabilized zirconia substrates, fabricated from commercially available solid electrolyte green tape. The fabricated sensor was placed in a vertical type gas flow apparatus equipped with heating elements. Impedance spectroscopy was performed upon exposing the sensor to gas mixtures containing NO gas in the concentration range from 0 to 400 ppm, while temperature and gas flow rate were kept constant throughout the measurements. For frequencies spanning from 30 mHz to 100 kHz, the impedance response of the fabricated sensor to the NO gas presence was investigated at temperatures in the range from 600 to 750 °C. The study confirmed that the sensor fabricated in thick film technology is sensitive to nitric oxide in the concentration range of measurements, 0-400 ppm, and when phase angle is chosen for a sensing parameter, linear dependency is observed at certain frequencies. The frequencies, at which maximum sensitivity is observed, as well as NO sensitivity values, are found to be dependent on the operating temperature. Impedance arcs found on Nyquist plots were fitted to an equivalent circuit and values of corresponding parameters were determined.

articleTitle: Optimal tuning for a double integrator plus dead time
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper deals with an optimal disturbance observer (DO) based filtered PID (DO-FPID) controller design based on the performance portrait method solved for a PD controller + double integrator + dead time loop configuration. By virtue of an equivalence of a dead time and n-th order filters used in DO-FPID control, the derived results may be used in a broad range of tasks originating in a control of plants with a dominant 2nd order dynamics, which will be illustrated by a noise attenuation motivated design for a positional DC motor control.

articleTitle: Battery regeneration technology using dielectric method
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to develop a method of charging with pulses whose frequency is imposed on the battery. Battery internal resistance changes depending on the charging status. A battery changes its actual capacity and also internal resistance, over time and therefore, frequency conditions can be imposed using dielectric and electrochemical impedance methods according to the battery status.

articleTitle: Data acquisition system for testing the insulation between the stator laminations of high power electrical machines
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents fault detection equipment used for insulation testing between the stator laminations of high power machines. To give more flexibility of a measurement system, a software component must take in consideration. This paper complete previously theoretical model developed. The equipment presented provides the opportunity to test the insulation between the stator laminations of electric machines for a wide power range with a clear diagnosis of the presence of defects in insulation between the stator laminations. The paper focuses on virtual instrument, data acquisition, control, and interface on the acquired signals.

articleTitle: Correlations between muscular contraction type and muscle electrical activity
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Each activated motor unit produces an electrical signal. By summing the signals produced at the level of each activated motor unit we achieve an electrical signal that can be recorded as electrical waves. In this study we aimed to identify a correlation between different types of muscular contractions and the muscle electrical activity. 23 healthy persons aged between 19 and 52 years participated to this study. By recording the electrical activity of the triceps brachialis muscle during its contraction it has been found that the strongest electrical activity of the muscle was produced during isometric contractions, followed by eccentric contraction, contraction with weight in the hand, contraction against gravity and contraction without gravity. In other words, as the muscle load is higher the muscle electrical activity is more intense.

articleTitle: Study about influence of power system operation and control of the piezoelectric actuators
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Electronical power and control systems can decisively influence the performance of the piezoelectric engines and actuators. This paper presents the modeling of some ultrasonic motor and the role of some equipments that amplifies signals of variable frequency with the lower limit of 20 kHz and various wave forms, in order to obtain new performance in using the types of engines achieved in the Research Center EMAD from Stefan cel Mare University of Suceava and to identify new applications of the piezoelectric engines and actuators powered, controlled and monitored by the electronic systems achieved.

articleTitle: Wet road surfaces detection by measuring the air humidity in two points
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents a contactless method for detecting wet road surfaces by measuring the atmospheric conditions in two points at different heights from the roadway and the road temperature for further road conditions determination through extrapolation. This method uses two temperature-humidity sensors placed one near on the road and the other one on the top of the vehicle and an infrared temperature sensor. Data acquisition and processing was performed using the microcontroller ATMEGA 328.

articleTitle: Low-cost low-power microgrid with photovoltaic panels
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents a microgrid with one renewable source, photovoltaic (PV) panels respectively. To reduce the cost of the microgrid the authors propose an interface between the PV panels and the DC bus or the storage system with two DC/DC boost converters obtained with the help of a dedicated integrated circuit used for switch-mode power supplies (SMPSs) control. This module can be multiplied to extend the PV string. Also, the authors propose a simple module for the microgrid energy management. The AC loads are connected to the microgrid through a commercial UPS.

articleTitle: Magnetic fields generated by power systems. Some representative case studies
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The aim of this approach is to evaluate magnetic fields generated by the power system, which humans can be exposed to. This study is preliminary and aims the development of a risk of exposure assessment questionnaire. The measurements are performed for some case studies representative for: houses, apartments, public areas situated near or far from power grid, also a statistical analysis of measurement results is performed. The background magnetic field levels were in the range of 10 to 519 nT with high space and temporal variability.

articleTitle: Analysis of transient short circuit currents and fluxes expressions of induction machines
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper, the transient current and flux expressions of an induction machine have been analyzed in the case of a three phase short circuit of the supply network. The starting point is the limitations of the simplified expressions, and the difference between the shape of the signals obtained via simulation and mathematical expressions. Mathematical expressions for currents and fluxes are derived, abandoning most simplifications, and the new results match the references. Subjected to analysis are the damping time constants, the components of currents and fluxes and the general shape of the transient; the peak of the stator current and the time of its occurrence are precisely determined.

articleTitle: Ignition modelling of a double sparking plug for internal combustion engines
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In order to improve the ignition system for internal combustion engines (ICE) a plug system with a double spark has been proposed. It can be obtained by modifying a conventional spark plug and adding an additional, floating potential, electrode between the two main electrodes, typically used. In order to validate the functionality of the double spark plug, in-situ experiments on an engine block, and different types of analysis (electrical, physical, chemical and mechanical) have been performed This paper presents a simulation of the spark discharge ignition in the case of the double spark plug and for the classic system, respectively, by using COMSOL Multiphysics. This simulation is essential in the case of the double spark plug, because it allows an optimization of its construction, determining the most advantageous position of the unpowered electrode relative to the upper electrode powered at high voltage.

articleTitle: Design of data acquisition system for environmental sensors manufactured in LTCC technology
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper a new architecture of a continuous sensors monitoring system based on charge amplifier and ARM microcontroller is proposed. In particular the electrical circuit, the schematic of a double system monitoring of sensors and Labview user interface were designed.

articleTitle: Aeration solution of water used by hydraulic turbines to respect the environmental policies
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Preserving the quality of the water is a major concern from ecological, economical and sustainable development point of view, but also a condition when using water for renewable energy production. The European Water Policy defines a common regulation for sustainable and integrated management of water corps and requires that all impact factors to be considered. The environmental friendly concept represents a necessity for worldwide hydropower development. The dissolved oxygen in water courses represents an essential parameter which allows the preservation and development of aquatic habitat. The objective of the work is identification and study of a new solution which will contribute to improvement of the dissolved oxygen quantity in water used as renewable energy resource, so necessary to the aquatic life. The proposed solution takes in consideration the optimum between aeration parameters and energy consumption, in order to be implemented in hydraulic turbines

articleTitle: Detection of positions and recognition of brand logos visible on images captured using mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Up till now there does not exist an easy, mobile mechanism that allows to easily capture, recognize and count defined, multiple objects that are visible in surroundings of the user. For this purpose, feature detectors (such as SIFT, SURF or BRISK) are utilized to create a database of products box images and extracted keypoints are stored. Existing algorithms based on keypoints analysis do not allow to identify multiple identical logos, due to the fact that a homography calculated on found keypoints can span two or more objects and the result then can be skewed. In this paper a solution to this problem will be shown, that by using a sliding window that joins multiple found keypoints into individual objects, it is possible to correctly detect multiple identical objects. In this paper preliminary results of a mobile framework that allows recognition and counting of visible products in surroundings of the user will be presented.

articleTitle: Sensing the hemodynamic of the brachial-ulnar-radial arterial system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Blood pressure measurement (BPM) is the most convenient, standard method of investigation for the cardiovascular activity. This study is concerned with its usage for the evaluation of the flow in the brachial-ulnar-radial tree together with waveform-based techniques such as the applanation tonometry, from the perspective of the capacitive pressure sensors (CPSs). First, we consider a concept CPS usable for BPM. Next, we built a realistic computational domain that represents the right arm of an adult using medical images and reconstruction techniques. A mathematical model for the blood flow-arm-CPS interactions and its finite element implementation, are presented and used to study these phenomena. Finally, we present numerical simulation results that may conveniently be used to analyze the cardiovascular activity monitored through CPS - BMP methods.

articleTitle: Multiobjective optimization of an induction heating device using evolutionary algorithms
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents a GA based multiobjective optimization of an induction heating applicator for semiconductor processing. Two objectives are imposed: minimization of the power density non-uniformity in the load and maximization of the total absorbed power. The applicator is an improved version of the zone-controlled one proposed in literature, that uses partial or total shielding. A new adaptive ranking scheme is introduced in order to asses the different priorities of the two objectives.

articleTitle: SALEIE: An EU project aiming to propose new EIE curricula oriented to key global technical challenges
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: For the last two decades The European Association for Education in Electrical and Information Engineering (EAEEIE) has been dedicated and continue to support the Electrical and Information Engineering (EIE) education in Europe. SALEIE (Strategic Alignment of Electrical and Information Engineering in European Higher Education Institutions) is one of its new EU projects which coagulate a global team aiming to provide higher education models in the EIE disciplines that can respond to the key global technical challenges. The SALEIE project's work package WP3 (Global Challenges) is related to: state-of-the-art in implementation of the Bologna recommendation for Bachelor and Master, EIE connected technical, existing models in EIE higher education and their degree of response to key global technical challenges as well as some examples of curriculum models which see the day light during the SALEIE workshops. That is the subject that the proposed paper deals on.

articleTitle: Approaching a career in bioengineering or biomedical engineering 20 years of bioengineering education in Iasi, Romania
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The existence of so many terrible and incurable diseases, among which cardiovascular, neurodegenerative and psychic diseases, cancers, even a newcomer - obesity - emphasizes the permanent need of very skilled staff in health care. Besides medical and pharmacy specialists, the engineering branch has a main role in modern health care, characterized by high medical technology, powerful software programs for data analysis, and top management tools to increase efficiency of the health care system. Among many engineering specialties, bioengineers and biomedical engineers, even if somehow different, have a main common feature: the strong inter-, multi-and transdisciplinarity of their work. The paper analyses some characteristics of the specific education process in both fields, shows their sub-domains of activity, presents opportunities related to designing a career, presents specific aspects of 20 years of medical bioengineering education in Iasi city, Romania, and concludes that medical bioengineering and biomedical engineering belong to the top jobs, with a constant growths in demand, and are highly appreciated jobs, mainly in western countries.

articleTitle: Approach on simulating and measuring the SAR
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) evaluates the amount of radio-frequency energy, absorbed by a body, related to the unit of mass and to the unit of time; other words, absorbed power per mass unit. Undoubtedly, it is one of the main parameters used in non-ionizing radiation dosimetry. The paper presents a comparative analysis of the computed SAR (figures and tables), using CST software, for the human head SAM phantom. We have focused our efforts on measuring the resulting SAR from the five types of handheld transceivers, TETRA, GSM 900, GSM 1800, DECT and WCDMA (with the frequency of their carrier and the maximum level of field strength imposed by the ETSI standards). We have also calculated the significant values for the skin depths (mm) associated to the head type tissues, for these five carrier frequencies. With practical significance is the maximum value of the rms, averaged on 1g and respective 10 g of tissue. Even if the obtained values are below the limits accepted by ICNIRP, it is strongly advisable to reduce the time of intrinsic call, to use cell-phones of newer generations and not to keep the receiver tightly “glued up” by the ear.

articleTitle: Starting of large compressor motors on a weak grid - Case study
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents case studies of different starting methods of large compressor motors on remote locations where the grid is not strong enough to be able to start the motors Direct On-Line (DOL). Some criteria based on common practice have been presented. Following these criteria and making some rough calculations it is easy to anticipate how the installation will look like, what the grid influence will be and how that will affect the cost of electrical installation of a large driven compressor.

articleTitle: The bidirectional power exchange using a DC/DC converter with coupled inductances
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper analyzes the bidirectional power exchange achieved with a multiphase DC/DC converter and the possibilities to switch this type of converter between boost and buck operation modes. In particular, the topology and the waveforms of a two-phase DC/DC bidirectional converter with coupled inductances are presented. The currents ripples for two converters sub types, with uncoupled and coupled inductances, were calculated. The mathematical results for these converters were compared to each other and further with the experimental results.

articleTitle: 1 GHz low-thermal microwaves effect on mitotic division of vegetal tissues
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Low power microwave effects on Zea mays (corn) root meristeme tissues were studied in present work. Zea mays seeds exposed to 1GHz continuous wave for three different time durations and at two incident power levels were let to germinate post-exposure. Root tip cells in different mitotic division phases were investigated by specific cytological techniques in order to determine the mitotic index and the chromosomal aberration frequency comparatively, for the irradiated and control vegetal samples. Both mitotic and chromosomal aberration indexes were affected by the microwave exposure. A correlation between the exposure parameters and the effect intensity was obtained indicating a sensitivity of vegetal tissues on low-thermal microwaves.

articleTitle: A photopyroelectric measurement device for liquid investigation and monitoring
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A calorimetric measurement device based on the front photopyroelectric (PPE) configuration, consisting in a composite pyroelectric sensor and an irradiation LED, aimed to generate modulated optical excitation is presented. The proposed device is designed for on-field measurements and monitoring of a sample's thermal effusivity, when the investigated liquid is a semi-infinite layer. The composite PPE sensor is in fact a planar multilayered system, developed in order to have a rigid external surface and to allow picking - up the PPE signal by only accessing one side of the ensemble while the other side can be completely submerged in a liquid. The device is meant to be equipped with an internal preamplifier and an internal controlled current source in order to increase its independence and consequently in order to use it as a remote measurement device. A modulation signal conditioner has also been designed in order to provide a control voltage for the current source which drives the LED. The measurement device along with the modulation signal's conditioner, with the current source, and with the preamplifier is intended to be used with any embedded control system, provided with a multichannel analog to digital converter and which can deliver two control analog signals. Emphasis will be laid on describing the signal conditioning chain for the excitation source and the signal conditioning chain for the modulation element.

articleTitle: Testing of physical, mechanical and chemical properties of flakes and granules from thermoplastic WEEE selected by components
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Thermoplastic materials from electrical and electronic equipment are very common in phones, televisions, and personal computers. However, many plastic components are concealed and which are used for the connection of assemblies and components. The unique properties of the electrically insulating thermoplastic material, sound, resistance to bending, flexibility, and durability are that thermoplastics to be very important, as commonly used in electronics.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field strength distribution in Wi-Fi signals covered areas: An experimental analysis of the variables that influence the exposure levels
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The assessment of exposure to the radiation emitted by wireless devices need to take into account the complexity of WLAN networks and the quasi-stochastic nature of Wi-Fi signals. By analyzing only the maximum possible field strength and the traffic in such networks, one cannot accurately express the human exposure level. The type of transmitted information and the transmission protocol are factors that have significant influence on the field distribution in time and in amplitude. At the same transmission rate substantial differences may occur, depending on the traffic direction. All these aspects are analyzed here in different operating scenarios of WLAN devices within a network. The results of this paper show that the real electric field levels may vary between 15% and 80% of the maximum field strength - when measurements are made in the frequency domain only.

articleTitle: One possibility for the synthesis of autonom Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Syntheses techniques of Petri Nets are using both modeling general principles and the analytic techniques for structure and functional proprieties. Each synthetic method is providing a way for using general principles in modeling, which grant some set of compartmental and/or structure proprieties for Petri Net management structure. The synthesis can be done in the following ways: ascending - details are modeled separately and rigorously assembled into a global representation (unique) of the management structure; descending - one global structure's principle (unique) of the management structure is rigorously refined to include details.

articleTitle: AC interference assessment and impact on personnel safety
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents a software technology for prediction and mitigation the effects of electromagnetic field interference produced by the high voltage alternating current transmission lines (HVACL) on the underground metallic pipelines (UMP). The objective is to prove how the HVACL-UMP configurations can be numerically simulated regardless their complex topology (e.g. geographical position, number of pipes, transmission lines bonds and groundings etc.) and material properties (e.g. coating, soil resistivity etc.). The software accuracy will be demonstrated on a simple geometrical configuration with a well-known analytical solution. Practical results of the simulations on a complex configuration will be presented and analyzed with respect to the impact on the operating personnel exposure.

Author Keywords: high voltage alternating current transmission lines

articleTitle: New winding solution for the improvement of the three-phase induction motor performance
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents a new solution of the stator winding of three-phase induction motor that brings an increase of the performance by modifying the air-gap flux density wave towards a more sinusoidal shape. The concept involves different number of turns in stator slots accompanied by a modification of the magnetic circuit. Both FEM-based analysis and experimental results put in view significant improvements.

articleTitle: Evolution in calibration of electronic non-automatic weighing instruments
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Electronic weighing instruments consist of a load receptor, an electromechanical converter, an electronic processing unit, a display and an interface. The object of the calibration is the indication provided by the instrument in response to an applied load. The results are expressed in units of mass. When is not possible to use only standard weights, the substitution loads may be used. With each substitution step however, the uncertainty of the total test load increases substantially more than if it were made up of standard weights only, due to the effects of repeatability and resolution of the instrument.

articleTitle: High energy saving for africa street lighting using individual automatic dimming of HID ballasts
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper proposes and analyzes an individual automatic energy-saving device destined to the produce light dimming in the public lighting network dominated by high intensity discharge (HID) lamps and magnetic ballasts. The device is based on the single-phase voltage angle regulation and designed to switch the lamp's circuit input voltage within three levels 230V, 190V and 170V. The selection of the level is done automatically and depends on the time hour. The dimming device operation was first simulated and then experimental validated using two power levels (of 250 W and 150W) of high pressure sodium (HPS) lamps. This device can be a relative cheap solution for the low budget lighting systems, an opportunity for the city manager of lighting and electricity to get better energy efficiency.

articleTitle: A study of suitable resistive torque mechanisms for rehabilitation exoskeletons
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The need for innovative solutions to generate resistive torques during the rehabilitation exercises is emphasized. For the elbow joint of an exoskeleton few scheme are proposed, for rotational ERF clutches and ERF linear dampers. The dimensional synthesis of slider-crank mechanisms is presented and a family of mechanisms was obtained.

articleTitle: Operating theatre electromagnetic pollution generated by radio/electrosurgery. Medical devices electromagnetic interference
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of testing different radiosurgery and electrosurgery medical devices with the aim of highlighting the differences in the amplitude of the electric field emitted when these are used in the operating theatre. This is important due to the fact that medical devices are susceptible to high levels of electric fields and could lead to electromagnetic interference when subjected to the emissions of electrosurgical equipment. Different medical devices present in a classical operating theatre were placed under close supervision in the close proximity of the electrosurgical devices, in order to establish their susceptibility to the electromagnetic field emitted.

articleTitle: Real-time robust controlled driving system with permanent-magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper is concerned with robust vector control of a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PM-SM) using a fix-point DSP based computing architecture. Speed control systems are analyzed for different operation conditions. A hardware architecture was developed based on a TMS320C5x fixed-point processor, a PWM control unit realized in FPGA technology, an interfacing unit to the incremental encoder and A/D converters for the stator-phase current inputs, a high speed TDM-type serial bus and an emulating and debugging driver. The software was written in both, DSP-assembler language for acquisition and communication programs and in C language for the control algorithm computation. The computing system solution based on a minimal hardware configuration offers a flexible solution for different control strategies applied to a large scale of driving systems.

articleTitle: A new solar energy converting system with vertical photovoltaic panels
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A major problem of solar panels is the soiling of the surface caused by environmental factors (dust, snow). Cleaning (periodic maintenance) using different cleaning techniques is expensive and sometimes are limited by the fragility of the solar panels systems. There was an intense research concerning the cleaning methods of the solar panels, such as mechanic, ultrasonic and electrostatic methods, but they jeopardize the integrity of the solar panels. In order to remove the active substrate of the solar cells from the cleaning system, a new design of the solar panel has been developed. The new system proposed in this paper uses two vertical solar panels sided mounted along a forty five geometrical degrees mirror prism. The light coming from the sun is reflected horizontally, perpendicular, due to the prism to the photovoltaic panels.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of power quality on bus-bars of the main switchboard and terminal of exemplary load at marine microgrid
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper's aim is to analyze and discuss results of experimental investigation of power quality parameters at two points of exemplary ship power system. Namely, the bus-bars of the main switchboard and terminal of exemplary load (the electric motor of deck crane pump) have been considered. Particularly, measured voltage and frequency deviations are shown, completed by distortion analysis. The level of distortion and their propagation are presented.

articleTitle: Graphene layers used as cryogenic temperature sensor
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A resistive structure designed with graphene, thin 2D monoatomic layers of graphite, was deposited by dropcast method from a solution, on a ceramic substrate, between Copper electrodes. The obtained structure is proposed as temperature sensor and was tested in the cryogenic field down to 77K. The obtained numerical results from this investigation are compared with previous experimental results of calibrated sensors. The resistance/temperature characteristic shows that on the studied interval it can be numerically interpolated with the use of a polynomial low. The stability against ageing, the reactivation and the perspective to design micro sensors for cryogenic applications is taken in account. The experimental results show the need for structure coating with a polymer protective layer.

articleTitle: Assessment of rehabilitation degree in case of stroke by using image analysis of range of motion
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of our project for measuring the ROM (range of motion) for upper limb in case of post stroke rehabilitation, that uses a simple and accessible method for any rehabilitation laboratory. The system is comprised of a wheelchair with an artificial upper limb that has a laser light source that is projected on a plexiglass special design table. The table has a modular position thanks to the artificial limb. A small orthotic device with the light source is attached to the extremities of the upper limb. The laser light may be projected on the table, in horizontal or vertical plane, and the position of the light spot may be continuously recorded on a computer. The table helps as a reference system for the ROM assessment and also for computing some special measures (e.g., the value of the maximum movement amplitude). The design of the table is also useful for different exercises necessary for shoulder and upper limb rehabilitation. Using the digital recording and a dedicated image analysis software of the light spot it is possible to compute the capability of movement but also to assess the rehabilitation degree by comparing in time the positive evolution of the rehabilitation program. The device is distinguished by its low price of production, the simplicity but also the precision of the method and the capacity to include a computer rehab user interface.

articleTitle: Integrating electricity from solar energy in electricity power system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The global economy and modern life increasingly depends on electricity. In spite of the increasing demand and production, the electrical power grid has not changed a lot in last decennia. However, the advent and integration of renewable energy sources for electricity generation is having a drastic impact on the electrical power system. The photovoltaic (PV) technology contributes to a large extent to this change. In many countries PV systems generate electricity directly from sunlight at a cost that is lower than the price of retail electricity. PV technology has become a viable option for large-scale low-cost electricity generation. Due to the intermittent supply of solar electricity by PV, the load management, demand response, and storage techniques together with intelligent power management are developed to facilitate matching of the electricity supply and demand. The electrical power system is becoming complex and requires multi-disciplinary approach for successful system integration of all components. The future power system has to deliver what the global society dreams about today: reliable, affordable and sustainable electricity for everyone.

articleTitle: Numerical modelling of an electromagnetic actuator for vacuum contactors
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper, the authors aim to present the modelling, simulation and experimentation of an electromagnetic actuator used in the construction of vacuum contactors. In order to validate the numerical results obtained by computer simulation was performed and an experimental model. The role of the electromagnetic actuator is to achieve movement of the movable electrical contacts of the contactor with certain speeds and precise trajectories. The advantages of the electromagnetic actuator presented in this paper are the following: it is able to perform a large number of mechanical cycles (at least than one million), with high frequency, with high holding force in the closed position, through reducing air gaps and technology leakage flux, low power consumption, enrolling in a compact volume, reliable and low cost manufacturing. Using finite element simulation software, it was modelated and optimized an electromagnetic actuator with high performance, reliable, inexpensive that can be easily used in the construction of the Vacuum Contactors.

articleTitle: Automatic prediction of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in patients with heart arrhythmia
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A new predictor that takes into accounts the randomness of RR interval before PAFib is proposed. Using data mining techniques, temporal patterns are identified based their presence in ECG that precedes paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF) and not present in patients with normal ECG. The algorithm used the supposition that the premature atrial complexes (PAC) are responsible for most of PAF. Other statistical parameters that are related to randomness of signal are used to improve the accuracy of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of a novel type of ferrofluid actuator with permanent magnets in Halbach pattern
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A novel type of ferrofluidic actuator that uses a Halbach array of permanent magnets is proposed and analysed. Numerical simulations show an increase of the transmitted force and the preservation of the linearity of the force-current characteristic in the analyzed configurations.

articleTitle: About robust control on nonlinear chaotic oscillators
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Analyzing the behavior of nonlinear oscillators has revealed a wide range of phenomena specific to nonlinear systems. The Duffing oscillator raises a particular interest and has been studied frequently. Starting from a robust control method for chaotic Duffing-Holmes type oscillators, this paper analyzes the possibility of extending the method for other types of Duffing oscillators, with numerical simulation results supporting the theoretical considerations.

articleTitle: Management and energy efficiency study case concerning CHP implementation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The authors present the results of the implementation of a cogeneration system using natural gases and hydrogen at a Romanian manufacturer of chemical products, as well as the perspectives of development of a similar project. The results are given in energy and cost units.

articleTitle: Efficiency determination for the improvement methods used for planar structures applied on EMI filters
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The interest in planar technology began a long time ago, but it was mainly developed in the last few years, both with concentrated and distributed parameters. Planar EMI filters are among the planar devices developed with this technology. In order to increase their efficiency, one must know that the HF losses must be increased and the parasitic capacitances between adjacent windings must be decreased. This paper is a continuation of a study conducted on a simple planar structure. This time the improvement methods determined and verified were applied on the complex structure of an EMI filter.

articleTitle: Two-phase cryogenic flow meter
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Slush nitrogen is a two phase combination of solid nitrogen in liquid nitrogen. The measurement of mass flow rate of this mixture can be of interest for various applications due to the greater cooling performance, greater compactness and lighter weight. The development of a prototype of slush nitrogen (two-phase) capacitance type flow meter is presented in this work, together with the technological steps taken toward its fabrication. The flows characteristics of slush nitrogen between the armatures of the obtained flow meter are also numerically investigated using a mathematical model specially build for the tested device.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation characteristics PHV sources
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Renewable energy is one of the most debated engineering topic. The importance of this type of energy, as an alternative to the energy obtain by fuels or from nuclear power, made it possible the development of specific equipments: wind turbine, photovoltaic panels, leading to outstanding performance of these: MW power installed, sophisticated systems of command and control. This paper has as aimed the modeling and simulation in EMPT of a photovoltaic panel.

articleTitle: Rehabilitation of the tram DC traction with modern power converters
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper approaches problems of tram DC motors traction system modernization, system widely used in the area of Eastern Europe. First, the state-of-the-art and an overview of trams equiped with DC motors and classical rheostatic control system are presented. Poor economic status of this region only allows upgrading these trams with modern power converters. These improve the burning issues and allow reducing energy consumption and raising operational reliability. Second, the paper proposes the rehabilitation of the traction system with an new developped electronic module SDMC-103-04. In developping such a microcontroller based system is important to consider the characteristic problems in tram applications. Some of these problems relate to the friction between the wheel and rail (braking problems), or to the synchronization of the motors, when a multi-motor system is used. The developed module SDMC-103-04 has been tested on 71-605 tram type and confirmed the energy consumption reduction with about 30-40% and reliability increasing with about 20-25%.

articleTitle: Hybrid backup power source behaviour in a microgrid
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: By their nature, microgrids are dependent on the continuity of power supply and require backup sources with the highest degree of efficiency and availability. In addition, most users connected to a low voltage network have individual loads or groups of receivers that need quality energy supply (higher than those offered by the public grid) and they also require backup power source. The availability, redundancy, resiliency and effectiveness of a hybrid backup source (with batteries and supercapacitors) were analyzed in this paper by physical modeling a critical consumer. Experimental stand, scaled 1:9.5, is centered on supercapacitors' storage system, which supplies critical consumer in parallel with two batteries. Load profile obtained both with supplying through the converter and without control discharge, reflecting a very good coverage of energy demand.

articleTitle: Control architecture for power distribution systems based on IEC 61850, IEC 61499 and holonic concepts
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper proposes a control architecture for future power distribution systems, which combines the specifications of the international standards IEC 61850 and IEC 61499 with concepts from the field of multi-agent systems. Models for substation automation systems are proposed, relying on IEC 61499 function blocks for the implementation of the control logic and on IEC 61850 abstract services for communication and information exchange between the intelligent electronic devices. For efficient structuring and distribution of control, holonic models were proposed and exemplified for power substations.

articleTitle: RR interval prediction in ECG signals
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Prediction of a signal from recorded time series is always a challenging task. In this paper, the R-R intervals behaviour is estimated using linear and non-linear prediction techniques. The value of each sample point is predicted using a certain number of previous samples and the prediction error is computed. The wavelet transform provides multi-resolution analysis and allows accurate time-frequency localization of different signal properties. This paper presents a nonlinear prediction method from a first order discrete wavelet transform, implemented on artificial neural network based learning structure, compared with an ARMA model based prediction method. The followed parameter is the absolute value of prediction error.

articleTitle: Transducer Electronic Data Sheets: Why not print them?
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents a new approach to store and read Transducer Electronic Data Sheets (TEDS) compliant with the IEEE 1451.4 standard. The idea is to take the bit stream of the TEDS structure and store it on a non-volatile, easy-to-read, cheap support as is the case of 2D bar codes. The TEDS structure can thus be stuck to the transducer case or printed on catalogues, ready to be read anytime and anywhere by a scanner device. Experimental tests involving a Pt100 and a semiconductor temperature sensor are described to illustrate the concept. The tests include the generation of TEDS structures, their conversion to 2D bar codes and their reading back. The encoding is done online using a free web service; the decoding is done offline using a simple webcam and some image processing functions. LabVIEW code is presented to illustrate the encoding and decoding processes.

articleTitle: RASPIMON- Smart sensory system for environmental monitoring
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The authors propose a system able to monitor environmental parameters like temperature, humidity, CO, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, GPL, alcohol, smoke sensor and flammable gases. In the paper is revealed the advantage of using open source hardware and software at low cost and the way how to develop new smart sensors to be future used in application like intelligent buildings. Being portable, the system can be also used to build map of the air pollution parameters. The data obtained from sensors can be recorded on SD card with Linux operation system that can contain also a webserver and data base.

articleTitle: Characterization of ferrite materials used as a core for multi-phase coupled inductors
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In the process of design inductors with ferrite cores, one of important steps is the selection of proper core material. This work presents first steps in the process of development innovative multi-phase coupled inductor. Component will be used in MHz frequency region and it is intended to be used in the compact DC/DC converters. In first iteration, three types of NiZn materials have been selected as core materials for multi-phase coupled inductors. Results and analysis of ferrite core contribution to inductance frequency characteristic and Q-factor have been analyzed. SEM structural analysis and stress performance of ferrites are presented and analyzed in this work as additional parameter in process of selection. As result of this research, two ferrite materials are selected to be used as inductor cores in further development of component.

articleTitle: A Web-based E-training Platform for biomedical engineering education
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of the Leonardo da Vinci project (Transfer of Innovation), named “A Web-based E-Training Platform for Extended Human Motion Investigation in Orthopaedics”. The project addresses to medical and engineering professionals, proposing formation of specialists that will systematically apply the principles of medical and bioengineering sciences in finding solutions that will lead in improving health conditions. The main outcome of the project was a Virtual Training & Communication Centre ORTHO-eMAN for innovative education - on-line educational and training material accessed via a standard web browser, which provides an integrated on-line learning environment. Interactivity allows trainees to test their knowledge and provides immediate feedback using images and cases that they might encounter in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Efficient finned housing
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper reports a three-dimensional numerical study for the finned electric motor frame. The main objective is to optimize the housing geometry by choosing an appropriate number of fins for a given amount of housing material. A conjugated heat transfer problem is solved. Both laminar and turbulent flow with buoyancy effects is considered. In order to simplify the complexity of the numerical problem simplifying assumptions and simplifying symmetry properties are used.

articleTitle: Auxetic and kirigami systems in multiphysics and EMC applications
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Such advantages of auxetic structures like scalability, large volume expansion could be used to produce components with deployability and multifunctional characteristics. Kirigami allows cutting patterns that make possible the production of 3D complex structures (mainly cellular) using state-of-the-art manufacturing processes typical of thermosets and thermoplastics composites. New types of mechanical and EM responses can be obtained combining auxetics and kirigami within antennas/reflectors.

articleTitle: Weighted Value Analysis on the perception of various functions of electrical products
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A product optimization based on Value Analysis principle involves taking into account the end-user opinions on product expressed by the product functions. This point of view emphasizes differences between the manufacturer's perception and the end-user's perception on what functions of the product are important. These differences are also influenced by the end-users' segmentation according to the marketing principles. The paper analyzes the variation of the importance given to the functions of a product depending on various socio-demographic variables; the case study points to the flameproof electric motor users. Three types of differences are highlighted: (1) between manufacturer and end-user, (2) between the industrial and academic field (3) between users' experience in the field groups.

articleTitle: The impact of three-dimensional morphological changes and local properties induced by plasma treatment on polyimide films at the interface with some electronic components
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The morphological features and local properties of an semi-alicyclic polyimide film were closely evaluated by atomic force microscopy (AFM). These characteristics were optimized by applying high frequency plasma treatment, in order to increase their suitability for electronic purposes. Starting from the surface texture parameters, a deep analysis of the surface topographies at the interface with certain compounds was performed. The action of the plasma species generates a prevalent granular surface morphology, with higher roughness, improved bearing characteristics and minimal surface orientation. In addition, after the plasma treatment, a greater interaction between the AFM silicon tip and the polyimide film occurred, reflecting an increased surface adhesion. The obtained data reveal that the processed semi-alicyclic polyimide exhibits optimal features for microelectronic applications such as silicon/polyimide interfaces for flexible electronics.

articleTitle: Evaluating the influence of DECT transmission systems on sensitive medical devices
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of our performed measurements on the disturbing electromagnetic field associated with the so called Digital Enhanced Cordless Telecommunications (DECT); the results are synthetically displayed in polar coordinates, as circles with different radii around the active transceiver. Aiming to determine their realistic negative impact on specific medical device, we have proposed and tested a complete protocol, mainly applicable for equipment directly connected with the patient. There are analyzed the main frequency and power characteristics of the disturbances produced by the digital portable DECT phones, with specific focus on the electromagnetically overcrowded environment of an intensive care unit. As illustration purposes of the registered influences was chosen a neonatal mechanical ventilator, due to the great number of vital parameters that must be set and not disturbed. There are issued some recommendations regarding the relative emplacement of the base station the active, cordless receiver and the sensitive device that should be protected.

articleTitle: Implementation of the attractive radius method for the estimation of the lightning protection zones for a 110 kV power substation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Lightning strokes are one of the most disturbing phenomena when it comes of worldwide power systems reliability. Rolling sphere method (RSM) is widely used for dimensioning the lightning rod protective system of power substations. Although very used, this methodology was developed on the base of the late '60 electrogeometrical theory, which neglects some important parameters related to the lightning orientation process. With the development of the leader progression theory a new methodology for calculating the lightning protection zones emerged, known as the attractive radius method. In this paper this new methodology is used in order to estimate the lightning protection zones for a typical 110 kV power substation of Romanian's national power grid. The obtained results are compared with those proposed by the rolling sphere method.

articleTitle: Influence of rotor design over the back EMF of permanent magnet synchronous generators
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Over the last two decades, different types of permanent magnet synchronous generators have been subject of research. In this paper, four different topologies of rotors for synchronous generators have been investigated by means of finite element method (FEM). Our study focuses on the influence of these rotor topologies over the waveform and harmonic content of the back EMF.

articleTitle: Integrated service management and energy efficiency system through cloud computing technology
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents an integrated system for energy management provided through cloud computing. The system also includes a network of autonomous addressable, distributed modules, for metering the energy consumption and a module for energy consumption forecast.

articleTitle: Demonstrating effects of a dynamical feedforward control for the first order system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: An analysis of different 2DOF PI controller tuning methods in [1], [2] showed significant advantages of a noise attenuation oriented predictive disturbance observer based filtered PI control (PDO-FPI) against the traditional two degree of freedom (2DOF) PI control. Analytically, as well as by the numerical performance portrait method it discovered that the potential improvements in the disturbance response are significantly higher than those in the setpoint response. This paper shows that the PDO-FPI does not make use of the whole control potential regarding the analysed first order plants with a possible dead time. The corresponding control structures will be derived by augmenting the well known control loop with a reference model by an additional disturbance observer for an input disturbance. The theoretical analysis will be illustrated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Influence of knitting techniques on ESD performances
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Electrostatic discharges (ESD) cause significant losses to the electronic industry. To reduce these losses, is essential to develop solutions to protect the electronic devices sensible to ESD. On the manufacturing line ESD garments are used to prevent a discharge from the normal clothing of an operator. In this paper the influence of the knitting techniques on ESD performances is investigated. Nine samples made by different knitting techniques are investigated for their ESD properties. The method used for investigation is charge decay time.

articleTitle: Assessment of electromagnetic radiation exposure of embarked personnel on Romanian naval ships
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The issue of electromagnetic compatibility and bioelectromagnetic compatibility is critical onboard ships, especially on naval ships, characterized by a large number of antennas transmitting in various frequency range, and placed in a small area. The paper presents some measurements performed on a Romania naval ship, in order to determine whether the personnel onboard is exposed to dangerous electromagnetic radiations. There were considered several high traffic areas on the ship, and measurements were performed in two frequency ranges: 80-200 MHz and 200-2500 MHz, respectively. The results represent measurements of the far-field of antennas. Compared to the electric field strength limits for controlled environments imposed by European regulations, the measured values were definitely lower.

articleTitle: Analysis of endodontic therapy results: Radiodensitometric study
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The study aims to highlight the role of radiodensitometric method (based on video processing) in the analysis of endodontic therapy used in some severe cases of chronic apical periodontitis (CAP). Three patients (age 20-30) with severe chronic apical periodontitis were treated using non-surgical endodontic treatment. For each patient, conventional periapical radiographs were taken before and after treatment completion as well as after 24 months. The endodontic therapy used the usual stages of chemo-mechanical root canals preparation and calcium hydroxide paste for 14 days. The root canal obturation was performed with gutta-percha cones and endodontic sealer Endoflas (Sanlor) with antibacterial and remineralisation properties. The pairs of digitized radiographs were submitted to the radiodensitometric analysis (video processing). The signs of apical bone healing were observed on conventional radiographs and digitized radiographs after 24 months, for all treated patients. The degree of bone remineralisation for the cases with partial bone healing varied between 73.33% and 90.99%. The radiodensitometric analysis of endodontic treatment results is superior to the assessment using conventional radiographs, as it allows an accurate and quantitative assessment of the healing processes at diverse time intervals.

articleTitle: Fault current protection control by di/dt
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to present a method to anticipate the fault current that may occurs in the power networks. The method consists in the surveillance of the fault current slope. Comparing its value with the accepted overload current slope is possible to command the circuit breaker before the current rich a dangerous value.

articleTitle: Researches concerning a bioelectromagnetic laboratory for microwave radiometry
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: During the recent years, the microwave radiometry has developed many devices in the medical area. The applications of the microwave radiometry in the biomedical area permit the detection of the hot structures which appear due to a specific pathology. The paper describes the measurements of electromagnetic noise temperature, inside a MSR (Magnetic Shielded Room) destined for bioelectromagnetic measurements, namely its applications in microwave radiometry, the verification and calibration of the radiometer, and a very simple simulation experiment on a tumoral structure in a breast phantom.

articleTitle: Panels and profiles for constructions based on bio-composites
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: A biocomposite based on polyolefin or PVC with animal biomicrofibres (microfibres of waste flakes / feather) and different coupling agents and ingredients is presented. This composite is tested for being proved its superior qualities in comparison with classic material.

articleTitle: Establishing the optimal solution for retrofit of district heating networks. Case study
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: Modernization of district heating systems is part of European energy policies. The European Commission allocated financial funds for this purpose and a boost of investments can be noticed in Romania, during last years. Identification of the best retrofit solution both from economical and technical point of view is an important target under such conditions. The paper presents an analysis of four scenarios for the retrofit of district heating distribution networks. Each scenario is based on a different type of pre-insulated system: standard pre-insulated steel pipes, double pre-insulated steel pipes, standard pre-insulated PE-X pipes and double pre-insulated PE-X pipes. The pressure losses, the heat losses, the costs of investments and the cost of heat losses during the lifetime of the system were taken into consideration in order to establish the optimal solution.

articleTitle: Some considerations about time delay estimation of seismic signals
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper the problem of signal source localization is considered. The signals are generated by footsteps and received by seismic sensors. This problem is encountered in unauthorized intrusion applications. The footstep detection and localization is based on acquired seismic signals and based on time delay estimation between these signals.

articleTitle: Analysis of current pulse generated by electrostatic discharge simulator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper it will be analyzed a current waveforms of electrostatic discharge obtained from electrostatic discharge generator designed in SPICE Software, a waveforms obtained by the analytical methods using a dedicated software, Mat Lab, and the results will be compared with real waveforms in order to analyze the current pulse associated with electrostatic discharge.

articleTitle: Embedded system for increasing home comfort and security
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: In this paper a home automation system which brings new elements to existing similar systems is presented. These elements relate to continuous monitoring of comfort level, the weather conditions and temperature of an object by thermal radiation and detection the approaching of a storm with lightning activity. When the comfort level is dangerous, temperature of monitored object is outside predetermined limits or a storm with lightning activity is approaching, the system will automatically issue a warning SMS to a preset number. An SMS can also be issued in response to a received SMS from a known number. Issued SMS messages contain relevant data on situations that generated the messages. Being warned of the occurrence of these situations one can take the necessary preventive measures resulting in increasing the comfort, safety, reduced domestic consumption of energies and time savings.

articleTitle: Aspects regarding optimal design of low power synchronous motors
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The utilization of low power permanent magnet synchronous motors for driving electromechanical equipments means a substantial decrease of the exploitation expenses, because these motors have good efficiency and power factor. The optimal design of these motors aims at searching and choosing that machine which to the criterion minimum total cost and to certain restrictive correspond conditions imposed by the type of the drive. The paper presents several significant simulations which provide quantitative and qualitative information for the final constructive solution. The result of the optimal design was a decrease of the total cost with 15.3% and a decrease of the exploitation cost with 35.4%. As a drawback, we have the increase of the fabrication cost with 6.41% and an increase of the machine weight with 6.29%.

articleTitle: Wet road surfaces detection by measuring the infrared reflected radiation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents a method of optical detection of wet road surfaces by measuring the intensity of infrared radiation reflected from the road. Dry surface reflects infrared radiation with a wavelength of 850 nm differently than wet surface. Research shows that it is possible to differentiate between the dry and wet surfaces using infrared light.

articleTitle: Implementation of software changes in programming techniques learning
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: This paper presents a study about how efficient implementation of software changes helps students to better understanding of programming techniques and algorithms. The study is performed during last three years on first year students, considering applications classes for two first year courses: computer programming part I and part II. There are taken into account some partial results during the semester, final exams and also some questionnaires accomplished by students. The ratings for this study are imported from a database. The study is regarding around eight hundred students.

articleTitle: Simulation approach to improve power analysis network for integration of distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The capability of the classical network to support the level penetration of Distribution Generation (DG) has been present to analysis how to achieve a better integration of flexible demand of Electrical Networks(Mesh and Radial systems). Based on this analysis, two simulation algorithms have been proposed to reduce CPU time and memory, can help the grid operator to assess power situation and increase penetration level of DG. Firstly, It deals with an algorithm developed for power load flow studies in electrical power systems using Schur complement method. By dividing Jacobian matrix into two separated matrices with reasonable computation time, It could be avoided divergence of the solution. A next step that was applied concerned Data Compression for the Simulated algorithms conceived to study load flow calculation in electrical power systems. Real time monitor of grids required less computation time in calculation of power system analysis. It proposed an algorithm based on Run Length Encoding (RLE) method where no zero values are included. Matlab results obtained by applying these algorithms match the analytical approaches. Results have been compared with Newton Raphson and Fast Decoupled methods in term of influence of convergence properties and it's efficiency. These methods have been implemented and tested on several IEEE bus test systems.

articleTitle: The advantages of numerical analysis for claw pole alternator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper analyses the models of claw pole alternators realized in practice, as well as the models that are more difficult to realize constructively, but, based on simulations and numerical analysis of the field, they are compared to the classic model to increase the production of electrical energy. After numerical analysis, the program created with Magnet 6.1 can automatically change and it creates a new model. These programs of analysis and verification ensure the safety of a proper design and test new variants of constructing the claw-pole alternator, even if they are difficult to realize in practice.

articleTitle: Computer tools in electrical engineering education
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The site of e-learning www.e-lee.net has been carried out by the collaboration of four universities from Belgium, France, Portugal and Romania, along a period of three years. This paper makes a general presentation of this site, with emphasis on an application dedicated to reluctance synchronous motor. There are presented the construction, operation principle, equations and a few characteristics in dynamic regime. The paper ends with conclusions emerged from the study.

articleTitle: Expanding the functionality of an EMF spectrum analyzer with self-performed near field probes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering (EPE)
abstract: The paper presents the constructive solutions applied for the fabrication of three loop magnetic probes, followed by the affordable calibrating procedures. The performance factors obtained after these processes (edited as .csv format, each one associated with the corresponding calibration graph) were used in association with SPECTRAN NF-5035 capabilities, the selected option (from the main menu) for the sensor being “analog”. The main advantage is that we can identify the emissive points in narrow environments, where it is impossible to place the already integrated, included sensors of the analyzer. Due to the usage of an exterior directional loop probe, it is more intuitive to establish the location of the emissive points. There are demonstrated some advantages of using cheap, self-performed probes, enhanced by means of all the processing facilities offered by a handheld, cunning low frequency spectrum analyzer and its associated software.

articleTitle: A low frequency current transducer using amorphous materials
